question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7e5ca29616c377e03c29bea727ea4b6e0d8ece38366fed87b5026622025fe9c.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: The Symbol '**Diamond**' is getting rotated in clockwise direction and also getting shaded alternatively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa98d5a706193ad0bd297226b3a54ce22546413c17da3e385a8e7178edfa742b.png] 

Step II: The Symbol 'Circle' is getting rotated in clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/184ba8e3849472999efd1a60ec49240279c120e4ef05d5680adb0ddb62e5e691.png] 

Step III: The figures are arranged similar alternatively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77b4e160cb90df0c4665347d4765064ce98d8b6aee523d1aee1d65af5003594b.png] 

So, the complete series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8dc8befc4091254a89af652a15b4d4f78259eb11da8cd334da7638ea444ee2ff.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
